MAJOR stands: this is the only screen for the tool grant, it offers a mutation that makes the card unpublishable, and it reports green while the card is in that state; separately it presents nine verbs the voice runtime always keeps (grant.py:57-69, :88, :213; voice/tools.py:38, :2918) as optional and removable, which is false in both directions.

AgentCardPanels.tsx:95 picks only G6 out of preview.data.gates; :129-140 renders that one lozenge and nothing for G4 or G9. compile.py:724-751 is the G9 body: allowed_scope = include | locked | PLATFORM_SKILL_TOOLS (:733) and any pack tool in the catalog but outside that scope lands in `tools_not_on_card` (:735-747) — precisely what Remove produces. The trigger is real on the shipped card: kaia-v2-4 attaches verify-and-disclose (skills/defaults.py:22-31), whose SKILL.md allowed-tools lists set_contact_preference, and set_contact_preference is on _COLLECTIONS_TOOLS (cards/defaults.py:80). Removing it leaves the tab showing 'G6 pass' and makes publish fail G9. The full report exists only in PublishDialog.tsx:174-180 (CompileReportList) after the manual runCompile. MINOR is right — publish fails closed, the cost is a late and unexplained rejection.

AgentCardPanels.tsx:133 is `tone={g6.status === 'fail' ? 'danger' : g6.status === 'warn' ? 'warning' : 'success'}` — 'skipped' falls through to success. compile.py:682-683 emits G6 skipped 'no card' whenever card is None, and card stays None when AgentCard.model_validate raises in the G0 block (compile.py:557-567); the preview is still issued because AgentCardPanels.tsx:94 gates on isAuthoredCard, which is only `Boolean(card?.identity?.bot_id)` (agent-card.ts:346-348). CompileReport.idle_voice_tools defaults to 0 (compile.py:75), and `idle ?? '—'` at :125 prints 0 rather than a dash, so the strip reads '0 / 12 idle voice tools' with a green G6. The sibling CompileReportList maps skipped to neutral (:1027-1036), so the two renderings of the same gate disagree. Reachable: every card model is extra='forbid' and several ints are bounded (schema.py:223 max_sec ge=5 le=60, :239, :262, :334, :340, :364), so an out-of-range outbound value or a hand-edited key produces a G0 failure on a card the UI considers authored. MINOR is right.

The counter at AgentCardPanels.tsx:126 is `new Set([...include, ...locked]).size`. CardTools.locked defaults to LOCKED_POLICY_ENGINES (schema.py:114, :58-63) = four names, of which recommend_treatment and evaluate_live_qa have no ToolSpec (grep of agent_core/tools/catalog.py finds only evaluate_authority:437 and recommend_next_offer:723), so flow_graph.py:817-821 emits no row for them and the counter is permanently 2 above the number of rows showing 'Remove'. The always-on undercount also holds: voice/tools.py:2918 keeps `allowed | ALWAYS_ON`, and ALWAYS_ON is VOICE_ALWAYS (voice/tools.py:38; grant.py:88) = the nine flow verbs + capture_call_goal + verify_identity, ten of which are not on the collections include list. Caveat on the arithmetic, not the mechanism: _COLLECTIONS_TOOLS (cards/defaults.py:55-85) has 23 entries, so the shipped default reads 25 on the counter against 23 rows and roughly 33 tools built for a call — the auditor's 26/24/34 are each one high. The +2 overcount and the ~10 undercount are exactly as claimed. This also corrects prior 2g.2, which recorded the include/locked divergence as 'consistent today'; it is not consistent today.

Row state is `includeSet.has(t.key) || isLocked` (AgentCardPanels.tsx:155) — it never consults the compiler's effective_tools, which the preview already carries (CompileReport.effective_tools/idle_tools, compile.py:70-71). intersect.py:107-115: when the card has skills, `names = (names - SKILL_GATED_TOOLS) | (names & gated_ok) | locked_mouth | platform`, so any SKILL_GATED_TOOLS name (intersect.py:29-48) that no attached pack lists is dropped from the grant while still sitting on include. create_promise_to_pay appears only in packs/ptp-negotiate/SKILL.md, so detaching that pack reproduces it exactly. Stronger than the auditor states: it is already true on the shipped card — apply_goodwill is on _COLLECTIONS_TOOLS (cards/defaults.py:63) and on SKILL_GATED_TOOLS (intersect.py:45) but on none of the eight collections packs' allowed-tools, so kaia-v2-4's Tools tab shows apply_goodwill 'Remove' today while voice/tools.py:2918 never grants it and bot_tools.py:806-808 answers tool_not_on_card_or_skill. G9 checks only the packs ⊆ card direction (compile.py:733-747), so nothing turns red. MINOR is right — it misleads the author, it does not change runtime behaviour.

All four names are ordinary rows with an enabled button and 'optional'. capture_call_goal (catalog.py:158-181) and verify_identity (catalog.py:188-211) are VOICE_ONLY catalog specs, so flow_graph.py:817-821 emits them, neither is in LOCKED_MOUTH_TOOLS, and grant.py:88/:213 plus voice/tools.py:2918 union VOICE_ALWAYS back over whatever the card granted — Remove on verify_identity changes nothing on a call. load_skill (catalog.py:598-621) and run_skill_script (catalog.py:623-645) are channels=BOTH, so they are rows too, and intersect.py:105-106 unions `platform = PLATFORM_SKILL_TOOLS & catalog_names` into names with no condition, re-adding it at :114 and as the channel-filter extras at :116 — Add is a no-op because they were already granted. The intake trigger checks out: _INTAKE_TOOLS (cards/defaults.py:87-97) ends at load_skill and never names run_skill_script, so that row shows 'Add' today. MINOR (dead config, no runtime consequence).

The code claim is true — intersect.py:105-106 computes `platform = PLATFORM_SKILL_TOOLS & catalog_names` and unions it into names with no card.skills condition, re-adding it at :114 and :116, while the comment at intersect.py:50 says 'Always offered when the card has skills'. But the cited trigger is false and it was the whole of the stated harm: supervisor-brief DOES have skills — cards/defaults.py:330 passes skills=skill_refs(*SUPERVISOR_SKILLS) and skills/defaults.py:35 makes that ('supervisor-brief','qa-examiner') — so for that card the comment's own condition holds and nothing is widened beyond what the comment sanctions. All four first-party cards attach skills (cards/defaults.py:173, :293, :314, :330), so the divergence needs a card with every pack detached, and even then the widening is load_skill (which can only load an attached pack's body) and run_skill_script, whose spec is an enum of two pure functions with no shell, network or ledger write (catalog.py:623-645). Real, but it is a stale comment with no demonstrated grant-widening on any shipped card: TRIVIAL. What would settle a MINOR rating: a card in the fleet with tools.skills == [] whose resolved MouthTurn.tools contains run_skill_script.

Verified at both call sites: db_prompt_studio.py:838-857 (dry-run) and :1908-1925 (publish) each pass catalog_names=set(CATALOG.specs) and omit channel_tools entirely, though compile_card declares it (compile.py:526) and forwards it to effective_tools (:627-633) and idle_offered_tools (:634-639). intersect._apply_channel (intersect.py:79-82) returns names unchanged when channel_tools is None, so preview and publish compute a channel-agnostic set while voice/bot.py:1141-1143 builds the live grant with channel_tools={spec.name for spec in CATALOG.for_channel(CHANNEL_VOICE)}. identify_customer (catalog.py:214-231) and ingest_customer_document (catalog.py:684-709) are TEXT_ONLY, so either on include would be counted by G6 (compile.py:687) and listed in report.effective_tools while the voice grant drops it. Contained and latent: MINOR.
